newsitem.title: FRANCE: Euro Disney 1996/97 H1 loss widens.
newsitem.headline: Euro Disney 1996/97 H1 loss widens.

text.p: (Figures in millions of French francs unless stated)
Costs - theme park and resorts 2,017 vs 1,842
NOTE - Euro Disney SCA gave its results for the half-year period from October 1, 1996 to March 31, 1997 in a statement.

"The company's decision to maintain 1997 prices at 1996 levels in order to further strengthen the competitive position of Disneyland Paris is having a positive effect on attendance and occupancy, while somewhat limiting the company's potential to improve its margins this year," it said.
It said theme park revenues improved due to "a slight improvement in per capita spending".

Lease and financial charges increased by 68 million francs in the first half of 1996/97. The rise was due mainly to the reduction of benefits from the 1994 financial restructuring but that increase was partly offset by lower interest rates.
For the full fiscal year, the increase in lease and financial charges is estimated at 200 million francs, it said.
Euro Disney is 39 percent owned by The Walt Disney Co .
